title: Inverse Modeling for Laser Pulse Shape Design in Inertial Confinement Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.33096v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The achievement of practical fusion energy remains one of the most pressing unsolved scientific challenges, with immense implications for carbon-free power. A critical factor in the success of Inertial Confinement Fusion (ICF) is the design of a Laser Pulse Shape (LP) that can optimally drive implosions under stringent physical constraints. Traditional LP design relies on computationally expensive simulations and manual iterative refinement. We introduce the ICF Laser Pulse Shape Design System (LPDS), a generative inverse modeling framework that maps desired outcomes and target pellet configurations directly to optimized LPs. Crucially, we design a multi-objective loss function to ensure the generated LPs satisfy fundamental physical constraints and experimental requirements. translated_title: 惯性约束聚变中激光脉冲波形设计的逆向建模
translated_abstract: 实现实用化聚变能仍然是当今最紧迫的未解决科学挑战之一，对无碳能源具有重大意义。惯性约束聚变（ICF）成功的关键因素之一是设计能够在严格物理约束下最优驱动内爆的激光脉冲波形（LP）。传统的激光脉冲波形设计依赖于计算成本高昂的模拟和人工迭代优化。我们提出了ICF激光脉冲波形设计系统（LPDS），这是一个生成式逆向建模框架，可将期望的聚变结果和靶丸配置直接映射为优化的激光脉冲波形。关键的是，我们设计了多目标损失函数，以确保生成的激光脉冲波形满足基本物理约束和实验要求。此外，我们提出了约束条件化、修复（inpainting）以及基于梯度的激光脉冲波形编辑机制，以实现对特定脉冲特性的细粒度控制。
tldr: 提出了LPDS——一个生成式逆向建模框架，通过多目标损失函数确保物理约束，并借助约束条件化、修复和梯度编辑等机制，将期望的聚变结果和靶丸配置直接映射为优化的激光脉冲波形，取代了传统昂贵且依赖人工迭代的脉冲设计方法。
en_tdlr: We introduce LPDS, a generative inverse modeling framework that directly maps desired fusion outcomes and pellet configurations to optimized laser pulse shapes, using multi-objective loss functions to enforce physical constraints and fine-grained editing mechanisms (constraint-conditioning, inpainting, and gradient-based editing) for precise pulse control.
